method: Did not repeat the ten finished paper rounds. Three new public routes were exhausted, then Europe PMC open full texts were paired to the named author node or to a unique initial on that author's own affiliation line. Department had to match the directory. Office, student-number, other-hospital and other-department addresses were rejected.
